Bright studio lighting illuminates his face and the foreground desk. (2) Close-up shot of the thin black device held against a blurred outdoor background, highlighting its metallic texture and slim profile. A hand rotates the device slightly to show its thickness. (3) The device is shown being inserted into a black leather phone wallet attached to the back of a blue smartphone. The scene shifts to a black leather wallet being opened, with the device tucked inside one of the card slots. (4) Back in the studio, the man continues to speak, gesturing with his hands and holding the device. A side view shows another man holding a blue smartphone to his ear, with the black device clearly attached to the back of the phone. (5) Close-up of the device on the phone. A finger presses a circular button on the device, and a small horizontal screen strip lights up, displaying a battery percentage icon and dynamic audio wave levels. (6) A screen recording sequence shows a mobile application interface with Traditional Chinese text. The app displays lists of audio files, detailed transcriptions with speaker labels like '周朝先' and 'Speaker 2', and highlighted summary sections. (7) Transition back to the studio man. Several circular security and certification logos (HIPAA, SOC 2, GDPR, EN18031) appear as floating overlays around him while he talks. (8) The video concludes with the man looking down and interacting with the phone in his hand, which has the device attached, while the studio background remains consistent with neutral lighting.
